0022600135.text: The Pacers (2-2, 8th in the East and 3rd in the Central, one game back) host the 76ers (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East) in the fifth game of Indiana's season, after a loss in their most recent game. Indiana is listed without Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton, and Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard and Obi Toppin are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker and Tacko Fall. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Pacers lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
